description.narrative: The program aims to reduce poverty, protect vulnerable groups, strengthen democratic and peaceful values, and build community resilience in Mauritania. It supports women, youth, and people of slave descent through literacy training, vocational skills, and cooperative income opportunities that boost economic independence and social participation. Communities are equipped with climate‑smart farming techniques, improved water management, and resilience planning to better withstand environmental and socioeconomic shocks. The program also enhances human rights awareness within youth organizations and builds teachers’ capacity to foster rights‑respecting schools. By providing practical skills, diversified livelihoods, and stronger rights knowledge, the program empowers vulnerable groups to participate more actively in society, strengthens local community structures and development planning, and promotes peace, climate resilience, and sustainable livelihood opportunities.
